theorem confidence_cone_iteration {α : Type*}
    (safe : ℕ → Set α) (f : α → ℝ) (lower : ℕ → α → ℝ)
    (distance : α → α → ℝ) (L level : ℝ)
    (hseed : ∀ x ∈ safe 0, level ≤ f x)
    (hconfidence : ∀ n x, lower n x ≤ f x)
    (hregularity : ∀ a x, f a - L*distance a x ≤ f x)
    (hupdate : ∀ n, safe (n+1) = safe n ∪
      {x | ∃ a ∈ safe n, level ≤ lower n a - L*distance a x}) :
    ∀ n x, x ∈ safe n → level ≤ f x

declarations.limits: Confidence validity and a Lipschitz lower inequality are explicit local premises. No GP probability/concentration theorem, SafeOpt finite-time discovery, acquisition optimality, or all-time noise probability is formalized. cone_radius_certificate uses the undivided radius identity and does not justify division by zero.

theorem invariant_closed_loop {α β : Type*} (f : α → β → α)
    (policy : α → β) (safe : Set α) (trajectory : ℕ → α)
    (hstart : trajectory 0 ∈ safe)
    (hstep : ∀ x ∈ safe, f x (policy x) ∈ safe)
    (hdynamics : ∀ n, trajectory (n+1) = f (trajectory n) (policy (trajectory n))) :
    ∀ n, trajectory n ∈ safe
declarations.scope: Braking-position algebra, closed-loop invariance by induction, descending predecessor iteration, preservation of every controlled-invariant subset.
declarations.limits: Braking identity alone does not prove the full continuous-time double-integrator viability characterization, optimality of braking, feedback measurability or existence; predecessor iteration is not proved to reach its greatest fixed point in an infinite state space.
